method: Prepared local sources; warm filesystem, no object/compiler caches. Clean CMake Release Clang O3 builds include TinyCC/shader support. Goose bootstrap is pinned C++ source-to-C at language O0 plus GCC O0 or O2. Different feature coverage; not language-equivalent builds. Program timing includes fresh process startup, loading, checking, optimization, emission and writing Wasm; no Wasm execution or Python startup. Configured warmups, paired shuffled rounds at each configured language optimization level. Output bytes need not match. Final program cohort uses blocking subprocess.run with no timeout, avoiding timeout-wait polling. Build cohort is separately pinned.

build_cohort.note: Clean build observations reused. Prior program timings rejected due~1ms timeout-wait bias; this cohort has blocking wait.
